name: UN Human Rights Policy Framework
description: Standard framework for UN human rights policy documents addressing social inclusion, non-discrimination, and protection of vulnerable groups.
key_requirements: Explicit reference to international human rights instruments (UDHR, ICCPR, ICESCR)
Clear definition of vulnerable and marginalized groups
Articulation of non-discrimination and equality principles
Mechanisms for participation of affected communities
Accountability framework with responsible authorities named
Measurable targets and indicators aligned with SDGs
Resource allocation plan with budget estimates
Cross-cutting issues: gender, disability, indigenous peoples
